description: 函数A中引用了仅在函数B中定义的变量（跨函数复制粘贴导致变量污染）

abstract_signature.code_template:
def func_a():
    return $VAR  # $VAR only defined in func_b
abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 同一文件中两个函数，变量在一个函数定义在另一个函数使用
abstract_signature.example_fix: 在func_a中声明变量或从func_b传入

fix_template: 检查变量是否应在当前函数内声明，或从调用方传入

description: 来自外部输入的对象（request参数、文件读取、API返回值）直接访问属性/下标，未做空值检查

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 函数参数直接访问属性/下标，无if is not None守卫

fix_template: 在访问前添加: if $VAR is not None:

description: 函数调用时传入的参数数量与定义不一致（子Agent并行修改导致签名不同步）

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 同文件中函数定义与调用的必需参数数量不匹配
abstract_signature.example_trigger: track_event()需要2个参数但被传入4个参数

fix_template: 检查函数定义，确保调用参数与签名一致

description: import语句引用了不存在或未导出的模块（子Agent各自修改导致导出不一致）

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: import的函数/类在目标模块中未定义或未导出
abstract_signature.example_trigger: from executor_service import execute_group_task（该函数未在__all__中导出）
abstract_signature.example_fix: 确认模块中存在该函数，并检查__all__导出列表

fix_template: 检查目标模块的函数/类是否确实存在且已导出

description: 使用裸except或except块中仅pass/return空值，异常被静默吞没

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: except未指定类型或except块中只有pass/return None
abstract_signature.example_trigger: except: pass 导致所有异常被静默忽略

fix_template: 指定具体异常类型，至少记录日志

description: 源文件包含UTF-8 BOM字符，导致JSON解析失败或构建工具报错

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 文件前3字节为UTF-8 BOM标记
abstract_signature.example_trigger: package.json头部包含U+FEFF导致Vite启动报错
abstract_signature.example_fix: 使用Save as UTF-8 without BOM重新保存

fix_template: 以UTF-8 without BOM格式重新保存文件

description: 使用正则表达式解析AI生成的非结构化文本（Markdown/自然语言），格式变化即失效

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 正则匹配Markdown/HTML/自然语言文本
abstract_signature.example_fix: 改为JSON结构化数据传递，前端/后端统一格式

fix_template: 使用结构化数据格式（JSON）替代文本解析

description: 数据修改后前端未刷新/后端缓存未失效，用户看到过期数据

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 写操作后未触发读操作的缓存刷新
abstract_signature.example_trigger: 审计修订提交后，审计页面仍显示旧数据
abstract_signature.example_fix: 修订成功后调用invalidate查询或返回最新数据

fix_template: 写操作后主动刷新相关缓存或返回最新数据

description: 被注释掉的代码块，可能是AI生成后手动禁用但忘记删除

abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 注释行包含def/class/import/return等代码关键字
abstract_signature.example_fix: 删除注释掉的代码，或添加TODO说明保留原因

fix_template: 清理注释掉的代码或添加TODO标记

description: 多个子Agent并行开发导致函数/变量命名不一致（同概念不同名，或同名不同概念）

abstract_signature.code_template:
file_a.py: track_task_event()
file_b.py: track_event()  # same concept, different name
abstract_signature.trigger_condition: 跨文件存在语义相同但命名不同的函数/类
abstract_signature.example_trigger: 一个文件用track_task_event，另一个用track_event表示同一功能
abstract_signature.example_fix: 建立共享命名空间文档，统一函数/类命名

fix_template: 建立共享命名约定文档，代码审查时检查一致性

description: .env file tracked by git containing secrets
abstract_signature: .env in git index with API_KEY or DATABASE_URL
fix_template: Add .env to .gitignore, use .env.example for templates

description: package-lock.json or Pipfile.lock not matching dependencies
abstract_signature: package.json changed but package-lock.json not updated
fix_template: Run npm install / pip install to regenerate lockfile

description: Same package declared in multiple dependency sections
abstract_signature: Package in both dependencies and devDependencies
fix_template: Consolidate to one section based on usage

description: Source file encoded in non-UTF-8 or with BOM
abstract_signature: file -bi shows charset=iso-8859-1 or utf-8 with BOM
fix_template: Convert to UTF-8 without BOM

description: File contains both CRLF and LF line endings
fix_template: Configure .gitattributes with * text=auto

description: Binary or generated file >1MB committed to git
fix_template: Add to .gitignore or use Git LFS

description: Python/JS source file with chmod +x without shebang
fix_template: Remove execute permission: chmod -x

description: Symlink that references paths outside the repository
fix_template: Use relative symlinks within the repo only

description: Common generated files not in .gitignore
fix_template: Add standard ignore patterns for the project's language

description: Production config committed with dev defaults
fix_template: Use environment variables or encrypted secrets
